transcript: Mard, 44 saal. Kal raat le dast lagi hai. 8 raat neendafoxi hai. Dast mahul nahi hai. Jismatori paani ke kami hai. HB 10. Quadroxeras karein. Glastrofax lagazal 400 din mein teen baar, 5 din. Dulcolax parliogel cheezein band. Dagorbexaxab kam ho. Lactu foran wapas nahi.

advice: take Glastrofax 400 three times a day for 5 days
